contexts.text: They seemed as it were to roll off the coat of the left eye... HH 450.

Jehovah God made for the man and his wife coats of skin () = that the Lord instructed them in spiritual good, and in natural... Spiritual good, and natural, are expressed by a coat of skin. AC 294. AC 295.
The first came out red all over like a hairy coat () = the good of life of truth in the Natural... A hairy coat = the truth of the Natural.
A coat, in the Word, = that which invests something else...
A hairy coat = the truth of the Natural, because a coat = that which invests something else, here, therefore it = truth, because this invests good.
(Correspondence of the coats of the eye.)
He acted by a gentle and soft influx into the coat of the left eye... Such are they who belong to the coats of the eye...
He made him a coat of various colours () = the appearances of truth thence. A coat = the truth of the Natural. AC 4677:2, Illustrated.

Upon My vesture they cast lots... For the vesture = the Lord's Divine truth, which being the only Divine truth, and being from good, was represented by A vesture without seam, and woven from above throughout.
Aaron's coat (), has a similar signification.
Neither have two coats apiece () = truths which are from the Lord alone... A coat = interior natural truth.
They stripped Joseph of his coat = that they dispelled and annihilated the appearances of truth... The coat, being of various colours, = the appearances of truth. AC 4742. AC 4768. AC 4771. AC 4775.
Hushai the Arkite came to meet him with his coat rent () has a similar signification.

The coat falling off Elijah and being taken up by Elisha, represented that Elisha continued the representation. A coat = Divine truth, wherefore the garment that was rent in such mourning, was the coat.
(The inhabitants of Saturn) are girt with a thick skin, or coat, which repels the cold.
Like the cuticles, or coats, in the body. Enumerated.
The coat, and the cloak () = truth in the external form.
His garments represented truths in the external form; and His vesture, in the internal... Truths in the internal form are such as are in the spiritual sense of the Word.

A chequered coat () = the Divine truth there, inmostly proceeding immediately from the Divine Celestial. A coat = natural truth; but when predicated of Aaron... a coat = Divine truth inmostly in the Spiritual Kingdom, thus that which proximately proceeds from the Divine Celestial.

Thou shalt chequer the coat of fine linen () = the inmost things of the Spiritual Kingdom proceeding from the truths of celestial love... As the coat was the inmost of Aaron's garments, it = the inmost things of that Kingdom.
The Spiritual which is from the Celestial, is also signified by coats elsewhere in the Word. Illustrated.
Coats of skins () = truth from a celestial origin... The truth of that Church is signified by coats of skins.
The coat of various colours = the states of the good and truth which Joseph represented, which was the state of spiritual good and truth proceeding from the Celestial.

The clothing of the king's daughter (), means the coat, as is evident from the meaning of that word in the Original Language, for it there means the garment next the body. That it is a coat, is evident from , where the Lord's vesture is treated of.

As a king's daughter, and her clothing, or coat, represented such things, king's daughters were at that time clothed in such things, as is evident from , There was upon Tamar a coat of various colours, for with such robes were the king's daughters apparelled.

Nadab and Abihu were carried in their coats out of the camp (), for... the spiritual goods and truths which are signified by their coats had been defiled, and therefore they were carried in their coats out of the camp.

Ye pull off the coat from them that pass by securely (). Here, coat is another word in the Original Language, which nevertheless = spiritual truth and good. To pull off the coat from them that pass by securely = to deprive of their spiritual truths those who live in simple good.

To sue at the law, and want to take away the coat () = to dispute about truths, and want to persuade that it is not true; a coat = truth from the Celestial; for they leave to everyone his truth, without further ratiocination.
A coat = truth from the Celestial, elsewhere; Possess not... two coats ()... Two coats = truths from both the Lord and self.

The Lord's vesture = Divine truth spiritual from the Divine Celestial; the same as Aaron's coat... That the coat was not divided, signified that Divine truth spiritual proximately proceeding from Divine truth celestial could not be dissipated, because that truth is the internal truth of the Word, such as is with the Angels.

For Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats () = those things which are of faith. Coats, when predicated of Aaron, = the Divine truth inmostly in the Spiritual Kingdom, thus that which proceeds immediately from the Celestial; but when predicated of Aaron's sons, a coat = that which is of faith, for it = the proceeding from the Spiritual which is from the Celestial; this proceeding is what is called the truth of faith.

(Thou shalt put upon Aaron) the coat () = the inmost of that Kingdom. The coat with which Aaron was clothed = the Divine Spiritual immediately proceeding from the Divine Celestial, thus the inmost of the Spiritual Kingdom.

Aaron's coat represented the uniting medium of the Spiritual Kingdom with the Celestial Kingdom, wherefore also it was distinguished by a girdle from the robe and the ephod, which represented the Spiritual Kingdom internal and external.

Thou shalt put the coats on (Aaron's sons) () = a representative of the Divine Spiritual proceeding. The coats for Aaron's sons = the Divine truth proceeding from the Divine Spiritual which is represented by Aaron's coat.
(A woman of the fifth Earth wore) a coat which hung becomingly behind her.
The Lord's vesture = the spiritual sense of the Word.
If the tunics around the body were not in reaction...
Vegetations are brought about by the outer and inner barks and coatings...
Coats of skin () = the appearances of truth in which alone they were.
The prince wore a coat of hyacinthine silk under his robe... The courtiers wore vests of opaline silk...
The bridegroom wore a vest of shining linen...
The man was dressed in... a vest of shining wool.
A vest of resplendent linen under it...
Upon the vesture they cast a lot = that they had dispersed all the truths of the Word, but not the spiritual sense; this latter was what the Lord's vesture signified. AE 64:4. AE 195:21. AE 375:6.
The sclerotic coat.
The things of nature are as coats, sheaths, etc., to spiritual things.
They constitute the external tunic of the genital provinces...
The vest or inner garment...
To draw off the coat () = to deprive them of truths.
Coat () = interior truth; and cloak = exterior truth.
